results.title: Congress Demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s Resignation, Calls for Overhaul of ECI’s IT System
results.description: New Delhi, October 18, 2026 (Yes Punjab News) Congress General Secretary Jairam Ramesh on Sunday accused the Election Commission of India (ECI) of undermining public trust by allegedly withholding searchable electoral rolls from political parties for eight years. He claimed the poll body’s recent decision to provide voter lists in a searchable format came after […] The post Congress Demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s Resignation, Calls for Overhaul of ECI’s IT System appeared first on Yes Punjab News.
